entities.name: Jo Hea-jung
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jo Hea-Jung was a South Korean volleyball player, who was a member of the South Korea Women's National Team that won the bronze medal at the 1976 Summer Olympics. Jo died on October 30, 2024, at the age of 71.
